body:
## wave 3c — bundle air-gap transport + sparse-checkout focus

**Air-gap (sync without remotes).** `quilt-export <path>` writes a complete
`git bundle` (branch + HEAD + every `refs/quilt/*`); `quilt-import <path>`
lands it in a fresh clone: verify bundle, fetch the quilt refs a plain clone
misses, checkout the bundled branch, re-run quilt-init, then **regenerate
the journal from pure history** — walking every commit oldest-first,
re-running the deterministic receipt logic — and verify it byte-identical
to the journal carried in the bundle. `demos/airgap.sh` exports a ticked
repo, `rm -rf`s the original (the bundle is the only surviving copy), and
imports it on the far side.

**Focus (work one organ).** `quilt-focus <alias>` sparse-checkouts so only
`cells/<alias>/` + `.quilt/` are materialized; `--off` restores. The
received guarantee — focus is worktree-only — required a runtime fix: the
wave-2 `quilt-cascade` read the **worktree**, so under focus it saw only
the focused cell. It now reads the **index** (`git show :cells/...`), and
cascade updates to out-of-focus cells stage via
`update-index --cacheinfo` (+ `--skip-worktree` re-apply; `--cacheinfo`
alone clears the bit and leaves a phantom deletion). `quilt-tick` refuses
to tick a cell that is not in focus.

**Pins** (FAIL-first culture): `pins/failfirst-w3c.log` 0/3 on main →
`pins/pins-w3c-final.log` **P13 P14 P15 3/3 (26 checks)** + wave-2
regression **6/6 (23 checks)**, both ALL PASS.

- P13 bundle round-trip: post-import clone passes P1-style receipt check, watch.log regenerates identically, refs/quilt/* survive
- P14 focus: other cells' bodies absent from worktree; focused tick still commits + cascades; other cell's dial 14 verified **in the index** via `git ls-files -s` + `git cat-file`
- P15 `--off`: full worktree restored, no organ lost
title: w3c: airgap+sparse

body:
## What

Wave 3a extends the hooks runtime so receipts stop being working-tree
orphans and ride the branch itself:

- **Notes receipts.** `post-commit` now attaches the receipt JSON to the
  tick commit with `git notes --ref=quilt/receipts` right after writing
  `.quilt/receipts/<short>.json`. Notes are git objects, so receipts
  travel with fetch/push (plain `git clone` skips `refs/notes/*`, so
  `quilt-init` wires `+refs/notes/quilt/receipts` into
  `remote.origin.fetch` and fetches it). New `.quilt/bin/quilt-audit`
  prints every cell commit's receipt from notes
  (`git log --notes=quilt/receipts --oneline -- cells/` is the manual
  equivalent).
- **Signed ticks.** Receipts gain `sig` = fnv1a-64 over
  `receipt-without-sig || committer-ident || commit-tree` — a cheap,
  GPG-free, transport-level integrity mark tying the receipt to THAT
  commit by THAT actor. New `.quilt/bin/quilt-fnv1a` (pure-POSIX-awk
  fnv1a-64, validated against the reference vectors) and
  `.quilt/bin/quilt-verify`, which recomputes every noted receipt's sig
  and names any commit whose note drifts.

## Pins (FAIL-first)

`tests/pins_quiltgit.sh` grew P7 (note exists on the tick commit, JSON with
commit hash + alias + 16-hex sig, byte-identical to the file receipt),
P8 (quilt-audit lists all noted receipts; file receipts never cross a
clone, noted ones do after `quilt-init`, sig still verifies in the clone),
P9 (tamper via `git notes add -f` with a wrong alias → quilt-verify exits
non-zero, says MISMATCH, names the commit).

- RED first, against main's runtime: `pins/failfirst-w3a.log` — 6/9
  (P7 "no receipt note", P8/P9 "no such file").
- GREEN after implementation: `pins/pins-w3a-final.log` — 9/9 pins,
  41/41 checks.

## Honest limits

`sig` is an unkeyed checksum — re-forgeable by anyone; it catches
transport damage and lazy edits, not adversaries. Notes need an explicit
push refspec (`git push origin refs/notes/quilt/receipts`). verify only
walks `cells/` commits. Details in README "Honest limits".
title: quilt-in-git w3a: notes receipts + signed ticks

body:
## What

Every tick now publishes two **parentless orphan snapshot refs** via the new `.quilt/bin/quilt-publish` (called as step 5 of `post-commit`):

- **`refs/quilt/dials`** — a commit whose tree is ONLY the fleet's dial files (`cells/<alias>/dials/*`), no bodies, no links, no history. An agent reads the entire fleet's dial state in kilobytes: `git fetch origin refs/quilt/dials` then `.quilt/bin/quilt-read-dials FETCH_HEAD` prints `alias:dial:value` lines (`ls-tree` + `cat-file`, no checkout).
- **`refs/quilt/HEAD`** — dials plus `.quilt/live/last_receipt` (newest receipt JSON) and `.quilt/live/watch_tail` (last 20 watch lines): vital signs at a glance, visible via `git ls-remote origin "refs/quilt/*"` with no clone at all.

Snapshots are built in a private index (`read-tree --empty`, reuse committed blobs, `write-tree`, `commit-tree` with no parent) — the real index and working tree are never touched. Dates inherit the tick commit, so republishing the same HEAD is idempotent; refs are replaced each tick and stale snapshots leave with `git gc`.

## Pins (FAIL-first)

- `pins/failfirst-w3b.log` — RED on main: 6/9 (P10–P12 fail, refs absent)
- `pins/pins-w3b-final.log` — GREEN: **9/9 pins, 38 checks**

New pins: **P10** dials ref exists post-tick, holds the ticked value, no parent commit; **P11** dials-only tree (no cell bodies, every path is `cells/<alias>/dials/<n>`, with a HEAD-has-bodies sanity guard); **P12** live ref carries `last_receipt` + `watch_tail` (with this tick's line) and answers `git ls-remote . refs/quilt/HEAD`.

Never touches main.
title: w3b: live-state refs

body:
## What
Wave-3 quilt-in-git increment (first of the standing list): a **live position pointer**.

- `post-commit` now runs `git update-ref refs/quilt/HEAD HEAD` on every recorded tick (after receipt + cascade + watch line).
- New `.quilt/bin/quilt-head` prints the last recorded tick (`<short> <cells>`) and **refuses honestly** (exit 1, "no ticks recorded yet") on a zero-tick repo — never fabricates a position from HEAD.

## Honest boundaries (pinned, not prose)
- **Default clone drops it** — non-head namespaces don't travel with plain `git clone`; pinned as P8d behavior. Crosses via explicit refspec (`+refs/quilt/*:refs/quilt/*`, P8f byte-equal) or `git bundle`.
- **Cascade commits don't move it** — the pointer tracks *recorded* (receipted + watch-logged) ticks, not every commit touching `cells/`.
- Hook = runtime (P5 law), ref = data — no quilt-init needed to read it.

## Verification
FAIL-first: pins P7–P9 RED pre-implementation (commit f35caca, 6/9), 9/9 green after — 31 checks, 0 fail. P1–P6 untouched and still green.

Main untouched. Stacked on main tip 6a1ae48.
title: wave-3: refs/quilt/HEAD — live position pointer + quilt-head reader
